confirmed_gap.name: same_tenant_workflow_lineage_reassignment
confirmed_gap.description: The prior tenant-integrity controls validated same-tenant parents but did not universally prevent an existing project, document, or takeoff from being reassigned to a different same-tenant parent after authoritative downstream evidence existed.
risk: document project or storage evidence reassignment
audit chronology that no longer reflects the original workflow lineage

candidate_controls: Project organization remains immutable and a non-null opportunity_id cannot be replaced or removed.
A project may receive its first opportunity link only before downstream documents, takeoffs, estimates, proposals, or project approvals exist.
Document project_id and established storage_path are immutable.
A document cannot receive a late storage link after it already feeds a takeoff.
Takeoff project_id and established document_id are immutable.
A draft takeoff may receive its first document link only before downstream estimates exist.
Trigger function execution is revoked from public, anon, and authenticated roles and granted only to service_role.
Governance checker is registered in npm run governance and rejects RLS weakening, audit destruction, policy removal, and broad trigger execution.
Explicit evidence-first rollback instructions are included.
blockers: The BIDFAST preview for 8099ee3 remains pending.
The exact workflow-lineage provenance run and artifact are not visible through the first-page BrowserWorker workflow fanout.
The active Supabase connector cannot access governed project mhaovpyegtysfgualplu.
The active Vercel connector cannot inspect deployments in strategic-minds-advisory, so underlying dpl identifiers and logs remain unavailable.
The migration has not been installed or tested in an isolated governed Supabase branch.
Same-tenant reassignment, cross-tenant denial, downstream-chain protection, authorization, audit, rollback, and the full Account to Audit workflow remain unexecuted against live entities.
No approved route has newly demonstrated 0.99 visual parity, and complete light/dark multi-viewport source coverage remains incomplete.

rollback.database: No database rollback is required because the migration was not applied.
